units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 115a:25">B. Kam. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>זבניה לפ׳</he> he sold it to a Paphunian.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01402"><he>פָּפוּנָאֵי</he></cite>.
